about: IBITI Agent Arena crowd impostors. uv = [u0, v0, u1, v1] in three.js texture space (v up, flipY). size = [w, h] in metres of a vertical billboard (h already divided by cos(elev)). anchor = [x, y] share of the cell from its lower left: the floor under the hips. torch = [x, y] share of the cell where a phone torch flashes. head = [x0, y0, x1, y1] shares of the cell where headUv (in the heads atlas) shows the same head at about twice the texels. The lite files keep the layout (no heads atlas there); the normal maps are smaller, same layout.
